items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes, but this is a case of Mr. Bennock. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that right?

ctx.x: Well, they couldn't ask that. Because I was taught just to be a good musician and you play everything. If you can jump from a symphony orchestra and go right down into some hole in the wall and play the blues, that's what you live for. That's what you learn instrument for.
Yes, but this is a case of Mr. Bennock.
